pairs.question: Nam quis te, iuvenum confidentissime, nostras iussit adire domos? Quidve hinc petis?
pairs.answer: Deum praecepta secuti venimus hinc lapsis quaesitum oracula rebus.
pairs.derivation: Proteus, seized by Aristaeus, asks who sent him and what he seeks. Dropped the trailing speech tag 'inquit' (framing). In the reply, skipped the non-answering deflection 'Scis, Proteu, scis ipse; neque est te fallere quicquam sed tu desine velle.' (you already know, stop pretending) and took the operative answering sentence stating what he seeks; stops at the full stop ending the speech. Inline every-5-lines verse numbers (450) stripped; editorial quote marks normalized.
